keyboard_lines.source: if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { acIndex[type] = Math.min(acIndex[type] + 1, els.length - 1); els.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('highlighted', i === acIndex[type])); e.preventDefault(); }
if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { acIndex[type] = Math.max(acIndex[type] - 1, 0); els.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('highlighted', i === acIndex[type])); e.preventDefault(); }
if (e.key === 'Enter' && acIndex[type] >= 0) { e.preventDefault(); const si = Math.min(acIndex[type], els.length-1); if (els[si]) els[si].onmousedown(els[si]); acIndex[type] = -1; }
